title: Applies Faraday's Law
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the formula for maximum EMF (Em = n B A ω) or Faraday's law for the average EMF.

title: Uses sinusoidal relationships
description: Important: The solution correctly relates maximum, effective (RMS), and instantaneous values for a sinusoidal AC voltage.

title: Calculates time interval
description: Important: For the average EMF, the solution correctly calculates the time for a quarter rotation (Δt = π/(2ω)).

title: Correct flux change
description: Important: For the average EMF, the solution correctly identifies the change in magnetic flux (ΔΦ = B * A) for a quarter turn.

title: Pitfall: Wrong angular argument
description: Pitfall: Using sin(ωt) instead of cos(ωt) for the instantaneous EMF, given the initial position, or mis-evaluating the cosine of 30 degrees.

title: Pitfall: Unit omission
description: Pitfall: Final answers are provided without the correct SI unit (Volts).
